lang.name: English
index.alarms_tip: Alarms since startup (resets when the app restarts)
index.diff_processed_tip: How much the picture changed, on average, in frames that were checked for objects (change was above the threshold)
index.diff_skipped_tip: How much the picture changed, on average, in frames that were skipped (change was below the threshold, so no detection ran)
index.time_processed_tip: Average time to detect objects in one frame
index.time_skipped_tip: Average time per skipped frame (only compared with the previous frame, no detection)
index.buffer_tip: Memory used to hold the latest frame from each camera
movement.title: Events
config.zone_hint: Click the image to place the zone corners. Place exactly 4 points.
config.zone_no_frame: No frame from this camera — the detection zone cannot be set right now.
config.err_label: Label can only contain letters A–Z, digits, _ and -
config.err_duplicate: A camera with this label already exists
about.desc: RTSPcamTG watches your IP cameras over RTSP, detects objects with YOLOv8 and sends instant alerts to Telegram. It runs entirely on your own hardware, with no cloud services.
about.feature_rtsp: RTSP stream monitoring with automatic reconnect
about.feature_polygon: Custom detection zones, drawn right on the camera image in the Web UI
about.feature_telegram: Telegram alerts with a photo and the camera name
about.feature_local: Runs locally in Docker, no cloud required
bot.detection_auto_resumed: Detection resumed automatically: the pause has expired
bot.ustop_usage: Usage: /ustop 30m — a number and a unit (s, m, h or d), 24h at most. Plain /ustop pauses until /ustart.
